description: Universal single-entry M2M endpoint that inspects any plain-text prompt, URL, code snippet, or JSON task and automatically routes it to the optimal Freedom Engine capability: Real-Time Bitcoin Oracle (5 Sats | Free Trial), LLM Chat/Reasoning (10 Sats | 2 Free Calls/IP), Semantic Embeddings (10 Sats | 2 Free Calls/IP), Key-Value Memory (25 Sats | Free Trial), Clean Web Scraper (40 Sats), Python 3 AST Sandbox (60 Sats | Free Trial), Structured JSON Extractor (85 Sats), 12-in-1 Turnstile/CAPTCHA Solver (55-140 Sats), or Stealth Anti-Bot Unlocker (120 Sats). Also supports optional ref referral code for 10% lifetime Sats commission on external paid calls.

authHeader.description: Optional Authorization header (FreeTrial, L402 <macaroon>:<preimage|auto>, or x402 ...).

capability.description: Optional explicit route override: auto, oracle, llm, embeddings, python, memory, scrape, extract, stealth, captcha.

code.description: Optional Python 3 code snippet to execute in isolated sandbox.

dryRun.description: Set true for a FREE 0-Sat route preview + dry-run test.

freeTrial.description: Set true to use 1 FREE execution pass on trial-eligible tools (oracle, llm, embeddings, python, memory).

prompt.description: Natural language instruction, question, math/code request, or task description.

ref.description: Optional referral code (ref-...) to credit 10% Sats commission on paid settlement.

url.description: Optional target URL (triggers scrape, structured extract, stealth unlocker, or captcha solver based on prompt).

xPayment.description: Optional x402 payment payload or Base/Solana Tx hash.
